name: Culinary Kakkoii
source:
In this visual novel you get to judge the culinary creations of nine quirky characters! What to expect:
-Secret endings
-Comedic dialog
-Occasional breaking of the 4th wall

[From [url=https://kakkoiikrew.itch.io/culinary-kakkoii]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你可以评判九个古怪角色的烹饪创作！期待什么：
-秘密结局
-喜剧对话
-第四堵墙偶尔被打破

[来自[url=https://kakkoiikrew.itch.io/culinary-kakkoii]Itch.io[/url]]
